ground_truth.base_feature: balanced per-frequency key sign x in {-1,+1}
ground_truth.conditional: P(y=1|key)=1-noise for x=+1, noise for x=-1
ground_truth.memory: optional one scalar per key, centered within each (frequency, sign) cell

protocol.fixed: one finite per-key label sample replayed for every epoch
protocol.fresh: new independent labels from the same P(y|key) every epoch
protocol.optimizer: Adam with separate backbone/memory learning rates and cosine decay
protocol.training_statistic: per-key positive counts; exact Bernoulli sufficient statistic
protocol.validation: one independent sampled set, val_samples_per_key for every key; headline CE is reweighted by r to match the training key marginal
